description: With a saved voice profile, live captions label the user "Speaker 1" instead of their name. Question: does identity matching run during live capture at all, or does it run but the match thresholds (minScore/minMargin/minEvidence, irl-subt-f9n.5) or the label policy keep the name from showing? Evidence from the Even simulator 2026-09-14 (sttLive moonshine-base-en): speaker_clusters rows carry candidatePersonId person_f06da67a15074dd5b6bd with a candidateScore for rec_2e939b4aa05a474ab5fb L5 and rec_bc51692409814fb7bf84 L1, and post-processing identity reported "1 of 4 speakers recognized" (rec 1) and "0 of 1 speakers recognized" (rec 2). So a candidate is computed somewhere, but neither the live label nor rec 2's final identity used it. Trace live path -> candidate -> attribution -> speakerLabel, find where it stops, and fix or recommend thresholds.

comments.text: Findings: live identification runs (coordinator.ts liveIdentify, every 10 s, clusters with >=3 windows). Accepted matches name the speaker live via attributions + labelsVersion. The user's rec 2 (rec_bc51...) L1 scored 0.636 >= minScore 0.62 but evidence 6000 ms (3 x 2 s windows) < minEvidenceMs 8000 -> candidate, not accepted; post identity said 0 of 1 for the same reason. Rec 1 had no profile (person/profile created 13:11:48Z, rec ended 13:11:23Z). Pipeline gap fixed in rev sqwkxltq: candidate was overwritten by the coordinator's 1 s cluster flush and glasses never showed candidates. Open decision (not changed): minEvidenceMs sums overlapping 2 s windows at 1 s hop (plan §7.3 says 5-10 s clean speech); lowering it to ~5 s would have auto-named rec 2, but with a single enrolled person the margin check is skipped, so any voice >= 0.62 with 5 s would be named. Calibrate on real G2 audio (EvaluationView harness) before changing; interacts with kdl.15, since split clusters each hold less evidence.

title: Live speaker identification: saved profile shows as "Speaker 1" during capture
